environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed on ECS Fargate with identical worker configuration, connecting through pgBouncer 1.21 configured with pool_mode=statement and max_client_conn=200. The PostgreSQL 15 backend has default_transaction_isolation set to 'serializable' at the cluster level (ALTER SYSTEM SET). Additionally, pgBouncer's statement-level pooling mode inherently prevents multi-statement transactions from maintaining session affinity, meaning each individual SQL statement executes as its own implicit transaction. Because each SELECT and UPDATE runs in a separate serializable transaction context with no session persistence, the UPDATE statement includes an implicit WHERE clause validation through PostgreSQL's SSI (Serializable Snapshot Isolation) predicate locking — any concurrent modification to the same row detected during the serialization window causes the second transaction to abort with ERROR 40001 (serialization_failure). The application's separate check_balance and update_balance calls each acquire independent connections from pgBouncer's statement pool, and PostgreSQL's SSI mechanism detects the read-write dependency cycle across the interleaved serializable micro-transactions, aborting conflicting updates.
